title: The Counterfeit Spoilage
logline: When an agronomist fakes a catastrophic fungal blight to write off orbital grain reserves, an undercover inspector hires an outsider to intercept the smuggled harvest.

roles.description: An unsmiling food safety inspector who suspects half the system's grain surplus is being written off on paper and sold off-grid.
A brilliant greenhouse geneticist who figured out how to fake crop rot on scanner buoys to pocket the insurance payout.
The regional grain distribution monopoly that controls orbital silage silos.
An illicit distribution network that buys diverted food stores to sell at hyper-inflated prices in frontier belts.
A shielded bulk freighter running dark through asteroid alleys with stolen unblemished grain.
A massive pressurized drum station storing millions of metric bushels of freeze-dried wheat.
The disposal dock where condemned organic matter is supposedly flash-incinerated.

public_situation: Emergency phytosanitary alerts in {system} order the incineration of forty thousand tons of wheat following a reported black-rot infestation.
private_truth: The agronomist programmed sensor buoys to display false fungal spore signatures so the cartel could quietly siphon uninfected grain into ghost haulers.

beats.public_change: Agricultural safety officers lock down the primary grain silo and begin venting test chambers under yellow warning banners.

missions.reason: The inspector needs an outside pilot to fly close to the silo exhaust vents and sample the biological spore count before local officials clear the quarantine.
missions.private_fact: The inspector was already offered a quiet transfer and a five-figure bonus to rubber-stamp the disposal manifest without testing.

beats.public_change: Instead of burning the wheat, a clandestine bulk hauler slips out of the crematory slipway toward the outer jump gate.

missions.reason: The inspector needs the smuggler hauler disabled and its encrypted navigation manifests recovered before the stolen grain leaves the system.
missions.private_fact: The hauler is escorted by cartel mercenaries who were promised a twenty percent cut of the off-grid grain sale.

beats.public_change: The recovered manifest exposes the agronomist's bank accounts, but the cartel threatens to cut all food shipments to the station if charges are filed.

missions.reason: The inspector asks the pilot to courier the seized proof to the crematory security magistrate before the cartel's legal team obtains an injunction.
missions.private_fact: The agronomist is hiding inside the crematory control cabin, desperately shredding local disposal telemetry.

beats.public_change: With the evidence secured at the dock, the trust board and cartel reps arrive to negotiate the fate of the remaining silos.

missions.reason: The inspector needs the pilot to collect the encrypted transaction drive directly from the cornered agronomist before cartel security arrives to silence him.
missions.private_fact: The agronomist is bargaining for an escort off-station and will only hand over the decryption keys once docked.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the ledger implicating both the agronomist and the food trust. The cartel offers a fortune to erase the manifest, while the inspector demands full exposure.

options.label: Hand the unredacted ledger to the public broadcasting terminal to break the trust
Sell the ledger directly to the food trust directors in exchange for a quiet retirement payoff
Transmit the grain release codes to independent asteroid miners so they can claim the impounded silos

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the unredacted ledger.
resolutions.summary: The staged blight is exposed; {role:food_trust} directors face criminal charges while {role:rogue_agronomist} is arrested at the departure airlock.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved the Great Blight was just corporate paperwork covering up stolen wheat.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the ledger to the food trust.
resolutions.summary: {role:food_trust} quietly buries the investigation; {role:farm_inspector} is reassigned to an unpopulated buoy while the cartel shares the subsidy.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot transmits the grain release codes to the miners.
resolutions.summary: Using the leaked release codes, independent miners drain the silos for cheap flour, while {role:food_trust} and {role:black_market_cartel} swear revenge.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot drops the contract or fails the interception.
resolutions.summary: The cartel slips away with the pristine harvest while {role:food_trust} burns empty chaff and collects millions in disaster relief.

loose_threads.detail: Thermal scans of the disposal incinerator show no organic ash signatures despite forty recorded burn cycles.
Disaster insurance claims were pre-approved by the agrarian ministry six days before the blight was reported.

radio_hooks: Agricultural inspectors in {system} confirm fifty thousand tons of condemned wheat earmarked for burn.
Grain futures jump fourteen percent as {role:food_trust} warns of regional starch shortfalls.
Dock unions in {system} demand safety gear before unloading alleged blight silos.

voice_direction.farm_inspector: Flat, relentless, speaking with monotonous bureaucratic precision that hides intense personal fury. Never raises their voice.
voice_direction.rogue_agronomist: Nervously witty, over-explaining plant biology whenever pressed on inventory records. Changes the subject constantly.
